verdict.rationale: Convex calls itself "the open source, reactive database." Its docs say self-hosted Convex runs the open-source backend with the same up-to-date code as the cloud service, and the public GitHub repo get-convex/convex-backend makes the source readable. missing for 10: the specific license is never named in the evidence, and there is no independent corroboration that the license terms are genuinely open (e.g., OSI-approved versus source-available).
